title: Child and Animal Abuse Detection and Reporting Act
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.
summary:
Child and Animal Abuse Detection and Reporting Act

This bill requires the Children’s Bureau of the Administration for Children and Families to share information through the Child Welfare Information Gateway about the incidence of cases of child abuse that involve abuse to animals.
